lots.title: Provision of Water Risk Assessments
lots.description: Draft Terms and Conditions governing the supply of Water Risk Assessment services in Council Buildings by a Contractor to The Mayor and Burgesses of the London Borough of Bexley, under Framework 6278 (Lot 2). The Services are described in the document as 'Water Risk Assessments services in Council Buildings as defined in the attached Specification', with the detailed scope held in Schedule 1 (Specification) and the Pricing Schedule held in Schedule 2. The document sets out general contractual obligations (A-I), special conditions (Part 3), and TUPE provisions (S1) but the Schedule 1 Specification body is a placeholder in this draft and does not expose substantive technical requirements for water risk assessments in this extraction.
requirements: Contractor shall supply the Services during the Contract Period in accordance with the Council's requirements set out in the Specification (Schedule 1), the Code of Conduct (Appendix D to the Invitation to Tender), and the provisions of the Contract (Clause B1.1).
Contractor shall ensure all Staff supplying the Services possess the qualifications, skills and experience set out in the Specification and necessary for proper supply of the Services (Clause B3.2).
Contractor shall provide all Equipment necessary for the supply of the Services at its own risk, and remove Equipment on completion (Clauses B2.1, B2.3, B2.6).
Contractor shall carry out satisfactory DBS checks on all Staff, maintain a DBS policy and supply it to the Council at commencement, and keep records of all checks (Clauses B4.9, B4.11-B4.13).
Where the Services include a Regulated Activity, the Contractor acknowledges it is a Regulated Activity Provider under the Safeguarding Vulnerable Groups Act 2006 (Clause B4.17).
Contractor shall comply with Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) as set out in Appendix E to the Invitation to Tender, with Service Credits payable for Service Failures (Clauses F5.1-F5.4, C3A).
Contractor shall comply with the monitoring arrangements set out in the Specification, including provision of Management Reports to the Authorised Officer and Contract Manager (Clauses F7.1-F7.2).

Contractor shall comply with all applicable health and safety Law, including the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974, codes of practice, and any requirements referenced in the Specification (Clauses D6.4, D6.7).

Contractor acts as Processor for any Council Personal Data processing; processing must be performed only in accordance with Schedule 1, using appropriate Protective Measures including pseudonymisation/encryption and integrity, availability and resilience controls (Clauses E1.1, 'Protective Measures' definition, E1.15).
Contractor shall use anti-virus definitions from an industry-accepted vendor on ICT systems interfacing with the Council and cooperate to contain malicious software (Clauses E1A.9-E1A.10).
Contractor shall obtain and maintain all Necessary Consents (approvals, certifications, licences, permits) to provide the Services at no additional cost to the Council (Clause A7.1).

Contract Period template runs from 1 September 2020 to 31 August 2022 subject to agreed extension (Recital A); note the framework-level dates in the published notice differ and govern the live procurement.

Contractor shall transfer to the Council on request data on persons employed in the provision of the Services to enable re-letting and shall not artificially restructure its workforce near contract expiry (Clauses S1.6-S1.7).
